title: Shared article link shows "Resource Not Found"
what_happened: My colleague's link opens a page that just says "Resource Not Found". No article, no title, no hint where it went or what it was called.
expected: The article my colleague sent. If it moved, it should send me to the new address, or at least say what happened and point me to it.

title: Resources says "No articles published yet" though a colleague shared one
what_happened: The Resources page promises case studies and articles, then says "No articles published yet. Check back soon." My colleague sent me one from this site, so either it was pulled or the list is broken. I can't find any writing from them at all.
expected: A list of their articles, including the one my colleague sent.

title: Contact form doesn't say what happens to my details, and there's no direct email or phone
what_happened: The "Let's Connect" form asks for name, email, an optional phone number and a message. It just says "We'll get back to you soon." Nothing says who reads it or whether I'll end up on a mailing list, and I couldn't see a plain email address or phone number anywhere.
expected: A line saying a real person (for example one of the principals) will reply and that I won't be added to marketing emails, plus a direct email address for people who'd rather not fill in a form.
